entries.title: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth Phishing and Detections
entries.description: This article explores OAuth phishing and token-based abuse in Microsoft Entra ID. Through emulation and analysis of tokens, scope, and device behavior during sign-in activity, we surface high-fidelity signals defenders can use to detect and hunt for OAuth misuse.

entries.title: A Wretch Client: From ClickFix deception to information stealer deployment
entries.description: Elastic Security Labs detected a surge in ClickFix campaigns, using GHOSTPULSE to deploy Remote Access Trojans and data-stealing malware.

entries.title: Call Stacks: No More Free Passes For Malware
entries.description: We explore the immense value that call stacks bring to malware detection and why Elastic considers them to be vital Windows endpoint telemetry despite the architectural limitations.

entries.title: Elastic Security scores 100% in AV-Comparatives Business Security Test
entries.description: Elastic Security nailed it with a perfect score of 100% in the most recent AV-Comparatives Business Security Test.
